About.title: About us
About.metaDescription: DEMAL SPEDITION s.r.o. is a haulage company from Všemyslice near České Budějovice. Since 2012 we have been driving across the EU, most often to southern Italy.
About.lead: We are a haulage company from Všemyslice near České Budějovice. We provide international road haulage and freight forwarding, drive across the whole European Union and most often go to southern Italy.

2012.title: DEMAL SPEDITION s.r.o. is founded
2012.text: On 19 July 2012 the company is entered in the Commercial Register at the Regional Court in České Budějovice.

2016.title: First walking-floor trailers
2016.text: Alongside chilled goods we start carrying loose bulk materials too.

dnes.title: 14 own trucks
dnes.text: Tractor units meeting EURO 6, refrigerated and walking-floor trailers, all with GPS.

About.peopleText: Drivers and dispatchers regularly complete the training that regulations require and that we need for a good service.

Transport.title: Road haulage
Transport.metaDescription: International road haulage across the EU, mainly Czech Republic – southern Italy. Chilled transport under HACCP, walking floor for bulk goods, freight forwarding and CMR insurance.
Transport.lead: We have been doing international road haulage and freight forwarding since 2012. We drive our own trucks across the whole European Union.

relace.title: Routes
relace.p1: We drive to every country of the European Union, most often between the Czech Republic and southern Italy.
relace.p2: We collect the consignment at the loading point and deliver it at the agreed time.

chlazene.title: Chilled transport
chlazene.p1: We specialise in goods that must stay at a controlled temperature, mainly food. We carry these loads under HACCP certification.

points.a: HACCP is a quality management system focused on food safety.
points.b: We have defined critical control points for transport.
points.c: We monitor the temperature in the trailer online through its own GPS unit.

walking.title: Walking floor
walking.p1: Since 2016 we have also carried loose bulk goods in trailers with a moving floor. The load is unloaded without tipping, so you need no handling equipment at the drop-off.
walking.p2: Typically this means wood chips, sawdust and other bulk materials.

spedice.title: Freight forwarding
spedice.subtitle: for carriers
spedice.p1: Do you have free vehicles on the Czech Republic – Italy route? Thanks to our contract partners in both countries we can help you fill them, mainly with goods under controlled temperature.

points.a: Transport is insured under the international CMR convention.
points.b: Insurance with the Czech business insurer, covering up to 10 million, applies across the whole EU.
points.c: Freight forwarding is covered by the forwarder's liability insurance for damage.

Fleet.title: Fleet
Fleet.metaDescription: Scania and DAF tractor units meeting EURO 6, Schmitz and Krone refrigerated trailers, Stas and Reich walking-floor trailers. All vehicles have GPS.
Fleet.lead: We drive our own trucks: Scania and DAF tractor units with refrigerated and walking-floor trailers. Every vehicle has navigation and GPS with online tracking.

tractors.title: Tractor units
tractors.text: The tractor units meet the EURO 6 emission standard. Each one has navigation, a GPS unit and a phone, so the driver stays in touch with dispatch at all times.
tractors.photoAlt: Three white Scania tractor units of DEMAL SPEDITION parked on the yard

trailers.title: Trailers
trailers.photoAlt: Row of refrigerated and walking-floor trailers of DEMAL SPEDITION, seen from the back
trailers.reeferText: For goods that must travel at a controlled temperature, mainly food. We carry these loads according to HACCP principles.
trailers.walkingText: The moving floor unloads the load by itself, without tipping and without handling equipment. We carry loose bulk materials in them: wood chips, sawdust and other bulk goods.

tracking.title: We know where your consignment is
tracking.positionText: Thanks to GPS and data transmission, the vehicles are under constant supervision from dispatch.
tracking.temperatureText: The refrigerated trailers have their own GPS unit, which sends the temperature history of the cargo in real time.

Materials.title: Wood materials
Materials.metaDescription: Purchase, sale and transport of wood chips, sawdust, pellets and by-products of the wood industry.
Materials.lead: We buy and sell wood mass for combined heat and power plants, sawmills, pellet makers and other customers. We collect it with our own walking-floor trailers.
Materials.pendingText: Dispatch is happy to tell you the specifications, prices and current availability. You can also send a request through the form.

chips.name: Wood chips
chips.description: Chopped wood pieces from forestry residues and sawmill waste. Used mainly as fuel in heat plants and boiler rooms, and as a raw material for further processing.

sawdust.name: Sawdust
sawdust.note: from sawmills and wood processing plants
sawdust.alt: Pile of sawdust in an industrial yard
sawdust.description: The fine by-product of cutting wood at sawmills. Used as a raw material for pellets and briquettes, as fuel or as bedding.

pellets.name: Pellets
pellets.description: Cylinders pressed from sawdust and shavings. A fuel for boilers and stoves with high calorific value and little ash.

byproducts.name: By-products
byproducts.alt: Ends of pine roundwood stacked up
byproducts.description: Bark, offcuts, slabs and roundwood from the wood industry, which are used further as fuel or as a raw material.
